_about: Pages and keys of the generated profile for the MSFS 2024 default Cirrus Vision SF50 (VisionJet), in the form of c172-g1000.json (see its _about: positions row,column; each key copies a real saved template and changes only the fields under 'set', 'shell' and the title). Built with the SF50 input event list (docs/reference/InputEvents-SF50.txt, track A): BAT, NAV LT, STRB, LDG, PITOT and the autopilot VNV command are the list's B-vars (V-1); V-2 adds RECOG and ICE, FMS SPD and MAN SPD on autopilot and the systems and iceenv pages' switches from the same list, and PARK's command (the parking brake input event; the standard K-event failed in the SF50). The pages views, simrate, vspeeds, compad and xpdr are the C172 G1000 pages' keys as they are (views adds MAP in V-UX; since V-PAD the compad digit, CLR and ENT keys are Dynamic Buttons with a centered title and an image map that reads the press feedback variables X:XL24_COMPAD_LIT_... of XL24-COMPAD.lua, docs/visionjet-sf50.md 'COM pad: centered text and press feedback'); radios is the C172's radios page with hold to repeat and a BARO column (V-3); trim is the C172's trim page without its aileron trim keys (V-2). Since V-UX the main page is the VisionJet's own grid, no longer the C172 G1000 profile's: the autopilot modes HDG, ALT, FLC, A/T, NAV and AP in row 1; the HDG, ALT and SPD columns with their step keys in rows 2 and 4 (hold to repeat) and their readouts in row 3; the autothrottle column A/T, FMS SPD, MAN SPD and A/T DISC (a new key: the input event B:sf50_autopilot_autothrottle_disconnect, every press writes 1, read the autothrottle arm state AUTOPILOT THROTTLE ARM); NAV, APR, VNV and VS; AP, FLAPS, LDG and ATC; the folders in columns 7 and 8. The main keys it no longer holds moved to systems (BAT, PARK, GEAR and N1 in row 3; the NAV LT, RECOG, STRB, LDG, TAXI, PITOT and ICE switches in row 4), radios (COM1, CDI and the BARO commands) and views (MAP); FD and the XPDR readout left main (autopilot 1,3 and xpdr 1,2 are the same keys). First-level pages, opened from main: trim, views, autopilot, radios, simrate, compad, systems and more; second-level pages, opened from more: vspeeds, checklist, xpdr, engine and iceenv (checklist holds only its back key). The key tables in docs/visionjet-sf50.md are the reference; check.py compares them: '## Key table' (main) and '## Key table: <page id>' for trim, views, more, vspeeds, simrate, compad, autopilot, xpdr, radios, engine, systems and iceenv. 'phase1_keys' is empty: check.py's phase1 check compares the C172's Phase 1 keys. Not yet sim-tested. V-3 adds hold to repeat on the step keys of autopilot, radios and trim (a Simple Button with Hold Switch on: key down runs lua:XL24-SF50:HOLD(code), key up lua:XL24-SF50:RELEASE(code); the script Scripts/XL24-SF50.lua sends the events, docs/visionjet-sf50.md 'Hold to repeat'), a BARO column on radios (1,8 readout, 2,8 BARO+, 3,8 BARO-) and the FUEL CTL readout's LEFT/AUTO/RIGHT mappings. Since V-UX the hold codes 1, 2, 5, 6, 9 and 10 sit on two keys each, on main and on autopilot (the script keeps one state per code; only one page shows at a time). V-AT: both A/T keys (main 1,4 and autopilot 2,8) write the SF50's autothrottle arm input event B:sf50_autopilot_autothrottle_arm, every press writes 1, with the read AUTOPILOT THROTTLE ARM until V-AT2 (with the standard event K:AUTO_THROTTLE_ARM the key was reported as not working in the SF50 on 2026-11-25); their title_size 14 keeps the title as it was. V-AT2: both A/T keys read the same input event B:sf50_autopilot_autothrottle_arm, in the form of autopilot 1,7 FMS SPD (lit at 1, dark at 0), because on the ground on 2026-11-26 the B-var toggled at each press while AUTOPILOT THROTTLE ARM stayed 0, so the light never came on; A/T DISC keeps the SimVar read.

pages.note: Trim page as the C172's current trim page without aileron trim: elevator trim keys and gauge, rudder trim keys and gauge (V-2); hold to repeat on the trim keys, capped at 8 s (V-3)

keys.empty: Aileron trim: the SF50 has none (IE-SF50 lists elevator and rudder trim only)

pages.note: Views page as the C172's (V-1); MAP from the main page at 1,7 (V-UX)
More: V-SPEEDS, XPDR, ENGINE (V-1); ICE/ENV (V-2); CHECKLIST at 1,5 (V-UX); AUTOPILOT, RADIOS, SYSTEMS and COM PAD are folders on the main page since V-UX

keys.empty: PFD softkeys: the SF50's PFD has none (IE-SF50 lists softkeys only on the GTCs); GTC page: V-4
MFD softkeys: the SF50's MFD has none (IE-SF50 lists softkeys only on the GTCs); GTC page: V-4
AUTOPILOT: on the main page (2,7) since V-UX
RADIOS: on the main page (2,8) since V-UX
SYSTEMS: on the main page (4,7) since V-UX
Vx: no SimVar in the MSFS 2024 SDK
Vno: no SimVar in the MSFS 2024 SDK

pages.note: COM1 pad as the C172's (XL24-COMPAD.lua) (V-1), with centered titles and press feedback (V-PAD)

Autopilot with the autothrottle: G3000 course keys, HDG sync, VNV, LVL, A/T, TOGA and A/T MGD readouts (V-1); FMS SPD, YD and MAN SPD (V-2); hold to repeat on the HDG, CRS, ALT, VS and SPD step keys (V-3)

9: transponder codes use the digits 0 to 7 only (docs/phase3-transponder.md)

pages.note: NAV1, NAV2, COM2 as the C172's (V-1); hold to repeat on the MHZ and KHZ keys and a BARO column (V-3); COM1 at 4,2 and CDI at 4,3 from the main page, BARO with the main page's BARO commands (V-UX)
Engine and fuel readouts: N1, N2, ITT, fuel flow, engine run, ignition, fuel left/right/total (V-1)

set.Address: (A:TURB ENG FUEL FLOW PPH:1, Pounds per hour)

pages.note: Systems: BAT 2, GEN 1, GEN 2 guarded switches; bus volts, total load, engine run knob, starter and fuel control readouts (V-2); fuel control readout shows LEFT/AUTO/RIGHT (V-3); BAT, PARK, GEAR and N1 in row 3 and the NAV LT, RECOG, STRB, LDG, TAXI, PITOT and ICE switches in row 4 from the main page (V-UX)

Battery amps: which battery index the SF50's switches drive is open (V-2 A-3)

pages.note: Ice protection and environment: engine, wing/stab and windshield IPS, wing light, IPS readouts, oxygen, bleed, ECS toggles and knob readouts (V-2)
